from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class Party(BaseModel):
    """案件当事人信息。"""
    name: str | None = Field(description="当事人姓名或名称")
    role: str | None = Field(description="当事人在本案中的角色，如上诉人、被上诉人、申请执行人")

class MonetaryDetail(BaseModel):
    """涉及金钱给付的具体判项。"""
    payer: str | None = Field(description="承担给付义务的一方")
    amount: str | None = Field(description="金额或计算方式，如'15600 元'")
    purpose: str | None = Field(description="款项用途，如'房屋租金'、'赔偿损失'")

class CourtFee(BaseModel):
    """法院费用承担情况。"""
    fee_type: str | None = Field(description="费用类型，如'受理费'、'保全费'、'二审费'")
    amount: str | None = Field(description="费用金额")
    payer: str | None = Field(description="由谁负担")

class VerdictItem(BaseModel):
    """具体的判决/裁定内容项。"""
    action: str | None = Field(description="动作，如'撤销'、'维持'、'驳回'")
    target: str | None = Field(description="针对的对象，如'一审判决第一项'、'申请人的异议'")
    description: str | None = Field(description="详细内容描述")

class CaseMetadata(BaseModel):
    """案件的基础元数据。"""
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="案号")
    court: str | None = Field(description="审理法院名称")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="案件类型，如'继承纠纷'、'专利权权属纠纷'")

class JudgmentExtraction(BaseModel):
    """单份判决文书提取出的关键信息。"""
    metadata: CaseMetadata
    parties: List[Party]
    monetary_details: List[MonetaryDetail]
    court_fees: List[CourtFee]
    verdict_items: List[VerdictItem]
    key_quote: str = Field(description="文书中用于匹配的关键原文片段")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgments: List[JudgmentExtraction]
